summary.text: Suzanne Ness is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 66, in office since January 2021, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, she chairs the Adoption & Child Welfare Committee.

paragraphs.text: Suzanne Ness's career experience includes owning a business.
She assumed office in the Illinois House on January 13, 2021, succeeding Allen Skillicorn (R).

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists Ness as chair of the Adoption & Child Welfare Committee, vice-chair of the Appropriations-General Service Committee, and a member of the Appropriations-Health and Human Services, Counties & Townships, Energy & Environment, and House Human Services committees.
Ballotpedia lists Laurie Parman (R) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.
